heading.en: The right person in the right job

hook.en: A hospital may have the best machines, but without the right doctors and nurses it cannot save a single life. Getting the right people is the job of staffing.
hook.kn: ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಯಂತ್ರಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವೈದ್ಯರು, ದಾದಿಯರು ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವಿಲ್ಲ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಜನರನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವುದೇ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ.

objectives.en: Explain staffing as a part of human resource management

narration.en: A hospital may have the best machines, but without the right doctors and nurses it cannot save a single life. Getting the right people is the job of staffing.
narration.kn: ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಯಂತ್ರಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವೈದ್ಯರು, ದಾದಿಯರು ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವಿಲ್ಲ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಜನರನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವುದೇ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ.

body.en: Staffing is the managerial function of filling and keeping filled the positions in the organisation structure. It includes estimating needs, recruiting, selecting, placing, training, appraising, promoting and paying people. Every manager performs it, so it is pervasive.

title.en: On the board: why staffing matters

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Staffing fills the boxes in the organisation chart with the right people.
It helps obtain competent personnel and gives higher performance.
It ensures survival and growth, and avoids both overmanning and shortage.
It improves job satisfaction and morale.
The HR department supports managers: recruitment, training, records, grievances.

explanation.en: Staffing puts the right people in the right jobs and keeps them there; it is part of every manager's work and the managerial part of HRM.

passage.en: Staffing is filling and keeping __1__ the positions in the organisation structure. Every manager performs it, so it is __2__. It covers estimating needs, recruiting, selecting, placing, __3__, appraising, promoting and paying people. Staffing is the __4__ side of human resource management, which also includes specialised duties such as handling __5__ and maintaining labour relations.

body.en: Human resource management includes many specialised duties: recruitment, job analysis, developing compensation and incentive plans, training and development, maintaining labour relations, handling grievances, social security and welfare, and defending the company in lawsuits. Staffing is the managerial side of HRM.

narration.kn: ಮಾನವ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ, ವೇತನ ಯೋಜನೆ, ತರಬೇತಿ, ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಮತ್ತು ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆ ನಿವಾರಣೆ ಸೇರಿವೆ.

problem.en: A new software firm in Mysuru hired people without checking their skills. Soon it had too many testers and too few programmers, and good programmers left because of overwork. What does this show about the importance of staffing?

steps.en: Wrong mix of people: staffing helps obtain competent personnel.
Too many testers and too few programmers: proper staffing avoids overmanning and shortage.
Good people leaving: proper staffing improves job satisfaction and morale.

answer.en: Proper staffing ensures competent people, optimum use of human resources, and better morale.

points.en: Staffing fills and keeps filled the positions in the organisation.

points.en: It brings competent people and higher performance.
